Assignment: Determine the Human Development Index (HDI) global ranking of Finland as of late 2023.

Result: Finland is ranked 12th globally.

Evidence: According to the Wikipedia page "List of countries by Human Development Index," which provides data for the year 2023, Finland has an HDI value of 0.948 and holds the 12th position in the global ranking.
